weather.sourceSeasonal: Seasonal climate trend, not a live forecast
weather.hintRain: PRIORITIZE indoor/covered stops (museums, cafes, workshops, dining, malls), limit prolonged outdoor exposure, and suggest rain backups in notes
weather.hintHeat: High heat/UV: schedule outdoor stops early morning (07:30-10:30) or late afternoon/evening (>=16:00); prioritize lunch, rest, and air-conditioned venues between 11:30-15:00
weather.hintCold: Cool weather: prioritize warm dishes and cozy venues; remind travelers to dress warmly in early mornings/evenings
weather.seasonalNote: Note: Data above reflects seasonal averages (outside the live forecast window); use it for pacing and packing guidance rather than exact hourly predictions.

safety.motorbikeTitle: Distance too long for a motorbike
safety.motorbikeMessage: Riding a motorbike continuously for {km}km (>7 hours) is hazardous and exhausting. Consider splitting the trip overnight or choosing a Sleeper Bus or Flight.
safety.carMessage: This {km}km drive takes around 9–10 hours. Rotate drivers or take a rest break every 3 hours to stay safe.

flight.sameAirportNotice: {origin} and {dest} share the same gateway airport ({airport}, ~{km}km); no commercial flights operate between them.
flight.tooShortNotice: The distance between {origin} and {dest} is too short (~{km}km, below the {minKm}km minimum) for direct commercial flights.
flight.sameAirportAdvice: The {origin} → {dest} route (~{km}km) shares {airport}, so taking a direct Limousine/Private Car is faster and more economical.
flight.tooShortAdvice: The {origin} → {dest} route (~{km}km) is faster by highway Limousine or Private Car (saving airport check-in time).
flight.shortStep2: Optimal transfer: Take a direct Limousine or intercity taxi from {origin} → {dest} center (~{km}km, ~{dur}, ~{price}/way).
flight.islandTransferTitle: Shuttle to {port} & Speed Ferry to {dest} Island
flight.islandTransferDesc: Land at {airport}, transfer by shuttle to {port}, and take a high-speed ferry to {dest} Island.
flight.islandNotes: {dest} Island has no commercial airport. The optimal route is flying to {airport} and connecting via high-speed ferry from {port}.
flight.islandStep2: Leg 2 (Shuttle & Speed Ferry): Shuttle from {airport} to {port} (~{landKm}km) and high-speed ferry to {dest} Island (~{dur}, ~{price})
flight.farTransferDesc: Limousine or shuttle transfer directly from {airport} terminal to {dest} city center.
flight.farNotes: {dest} does not have its own airport; after landing at {airport}, take a connecting Limousine straight from the terminal to {dest}.
flight.farStep2: Leg 2 (Intercity Shuttle): Take a Limousine/Shuttle from {airport} to {dest} center (~{km}km, ~{dur}, ~{price})
flight.directNotes: After landing at {airport}, you can take an airport bus, Grab, or taxi (~{km}km, ~{mins} min) straight to your hotel in {dest}.
flight.directStep1: Main flight leg: Depart {origin} → {airport} (~{airKm}km air distance, ~{dur}, ~{price}/ticket)
flight.directStep2: Airport transfer: Shuttle or taxi from {airport} to {dest} city center (~{km}km, ~{mins} min)

bus.islandTransferDesc: High-speed sea ferry from {port} to {dest} Island
bus.directStep1: Main leg (Sleeper Bus / Limousine): Board at {origin} → {dest} (~{dur}, ~{price}/ticket)
bus.directStep2: Hotel transfer: Free operator shuttle or taxi from {destStation} to {dest} center (~{km}km, ~{mins} min)
bus.notesOvernight: Recommended: choose an overnight sleeper departing at 22:00–23:00 (often includes free hotel shuttle) to save one night of accommodation.
bus.notesDaytime: Recommended: book a door-to-door morning Limousine to arrive at your hotel by early afternoon.

train.islandTransferTitle: Connection: Shuttle to {port} & Speed Ferry to island
train.islandTransferDesc: Train stops at {station}. Connect by bus to {port} and take a speed ferry to {dest}.
train.islandStep2: Leg 2 (Shuttle & Speed Ferry): Shuttle from {station} to {port} and high-speed ferry to {dest} Island (~{dur}, ~{price})
train.islandStep3: Note: {dest} is an island without direct rail access. For faster travel, consider flying instead.
train.farTransferDesc: Shuttle / coach pickup at {station} connecting to {dest} city center
train.farStep2: Leg 2 (Connecting Shuttle): Pickup at {station} to {dest} center (~{km}km, ~{dur}, ~{price})
train.directStep2: Hotel transfer: Take a taxi or Grab from {station} to {dest} center (~{km}km, ~{mins} min)
train.notesMultiModal: Multi-modal route: Train arrives at {station}, followed by shuttle/speed ferry to {dest}.
train.notesDirect: Arrives at {station}; consider a 4-berth A/C sleeper cabin or soft seat for a scenic, comfortable ride.

road.motorbikeIslandTransferTitle: Motorbike sea ferry from {port} to {dest} Island
road.motorbikeIslandTransferDesc: Express ferry carrying motorbikes and passengers from {port} to {dest} Island
road.motorbikeIslandStep2: Leg 2 (Motorbike Ferry): {port} → {dest} Island (~{dur} crossing, ~{price} rider + bike)
road.motorbikeUnsafeStep1: A ~{km}km motorbike ride takes over {dur} continuously, exceeding the safety threshold (>{maxKm}km).
road.motorbikeUnsafeStep2: Recommendation: Switch to a Sleeper Bus or Flight to travel safely and preserve your energy!
road.motorbikeUnsafeNotes: Riding continuously for >{maxKm}km by motorbike is very risky. Consider switching to a bus or flight.
road.motorbikeSafeNotes: Start early (05:00–05:30), inspect tires and brakes beforehand, and take a break every 2 hours.
road.carStep1: Highway / national road route from {origin} → {dest} center (~{km}km, ~{dur} driving)
road.carStep2: Estimated one-way fuel & tolls: ~{fuel} petrol + ~{toll} highway BOT tolls
